Racing Bulls / RB.summary: Racing Bulls have introduced a circuit‑specific front‑wing setup, giving the team a new “Gurney” flap option to fine‑tune the front‑end balance. This tweak lets the car generate a bit more downforce on the straights while keeping the handling stable through the corners, which should boost straight‑line speed without sacrificing grip. In short, the extra flap could translate into better lap times and a stronger fight for points this weekend.
